caption: :> Corner arcade down on 5th Street. The CRT scanlines on this cabinet are legendary. Dropped 4 quarters on 1UP high score.
author: surfer

comments.author: arcade_queen
comments.text: :> INSERT COIN never looked so clean.

comments.author: guest_suretroweb_testerrfer
comments.text: This looks incredible! Testing centralized comment from static gallery on Port 3000.

caption: :> Found my old 1996 mixtapes in a shoebox. Recorded off FM radio late at night. Rewound using a hexagon pencil.
author: surfer

comments.author: lofi_surfer
comments.text: :> The pencil rewind trick! That brings back memories.

caption: :> Neon dusk over Akihabara. Snapped with my low-res digital camera. Check the blinking radio tower beacon on the skyline.
author: surfer

comments.author: cyber_deck
comments.text: :> City pop vibe is 10/10. What camera was this?

comments.author: retro_gazer
comments.text: :> The pink and cyan dithering is pure 1996 aesthetic.

caption: :> Booted custom BSD workstation. Check the pixel desk setup: large steaming coffee mug, compact keyboard, oversized mousepad, and potted cactus up on the top shelf. Blinking monitor & keyboard LEDs are soothing during late night dial-up compiles.
author: surfer

comments.author: sysadmin_claire
comments.text: :> Radical sprite work! The tonal shading on the beige casing and the steam from the coffee mug give it so much cozy depth.

comments.author: pixel_monk
comments.text: :> Love the clean borderless LEDs and the compact keyboard balance!
